## Polaris

##### Polaris: Promoting Safe and Responsible Off-Road Adventures

  * __ In 2014, Scouting America announced a 10-year partnership with Polaris, manufacturer of off-road vehicles, to promote off-road safety practices, respect for the environment, and the benefits of outdoor activities.

##### Empowering Scouts with Unforgettable Experiences

  * __ Through this partnership, Polaris provides all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), side-by-sides (SxS), and safety equipment to select Scout camps across the country. This initiative puts their products in the hands of tens of thousands of future outdoor enthusiasts, offering Scouts an unforgettable experience.

##### Fostering Safe and Responsible Riding

  * __ Youth enjoy riding ATVs, but ensuring their safety and promoting responsible use are crucial for the future of the sport and the environment. More than 40,000+ Scouts have completed the ATV Safety Institute Rider Safety Program qualifying them to ride ATVs anywhere. 
  * __ The partnership also promotes safe riding through the ASI Golden Safety Rules and the Helmet Hair Don’t Care Contest. Polaris and Scouting America work together to educate Scouts on the importance of wearing proper safety gear, understanding vehicle mechanics, and practicing safe riding techniques. These initiatives aim to instill a culture of safety and responsibility among young riders, ensuring they are well-prepared for off-road adventures.
